stem_book: What does it mean if the cyclic process is anti-clockwise on a P–V graph? (Take w as work done on the system, IUPAC sign convention.) (a) Work done is negative (b) Work done is positive (c) No work done (d) Work done equals heat absorbed
reason: Printed key (a) contradicts the lecture's own theory (p.4: anti-clockwise ⇒ work positive, done on system) and its twin L1 Q2 (clockwise ⇒ negative); manifest key b was right.
work: Anti-clockwise loop: net work done ON the system = enclosed area ⇒ w = +area > 0
